annotation.title_clean: Proposal for a Directive of the European Parliament and of the Council on the type-approval of motor vehicles with regard to their re-usability, recyclability and recoverability and amending Council Directive 70/156/EEC
annotation.title_en: Proposal for a Directive of the European Parliament and of the Council on the type-approval of motor vehicles with regard to their re-usability, recyclability and recoverability and amending Council Directive 70/156/EEC
annotation.summary_en: European Commission 2004 proposal for a directive requiring new M1 and N1 vehicles to be at least 85% reusable/recyclable and 95% reusable/recoverable by mass, integrated into EC whole-vehicle type-approval, with manufacturer preliminary assessment and a ban on reusing certain safety and emission parts. Unrelated to AI or robotics.
key_provisions_or_claims: New M1 and N1 vehicles must be 85% reusable/recyclable and 95% reusable/recoverable by mass.
Compliance verified in type-approval using ISO 22628:2002 calculations on reference vehicles.
Manufacturers need a Certificate of Compliance from a competent authority after preliminary assessment.
Annex V bans reuse of airbags, seat belts, catalytic converters, silencers and similar parts in new vehicles.
Exemptions for special purpose, multi-stage built and small-series vehicles.
